summary: ansible-core 2.19 now warns when vars_files paths use undefined variables, instead of silently skipping them; host-scoped variables like inventory_dir aren't available at play level where vars_files is processed.
questions: I get 'skipping vars_file item due to an undefined variable', why?
Can I use inventory_dir in vars_files?
Why was my vars_files entry silently ignored before?

answer_card.title: vars_files skipped due to undefined variable
answer_card.answer_md:
Since 2.19, an undefined variable in a `vars_files` path gives *skipping vars_file item due to an undefined variable* (it used to be silently skipped). `vars_files` is processed at **play level**, so host-scoped vars like **`inventory_dir`** aren't defined there. Use `playbook_dir`, a play/extra var, or load the file at task level with `include_vars`:

```yaml
- ansible.builtin.include_vars: "{{ inventory_dir }}/vars_files/bar.yml"
```
